title: 墨西哥活牛进口中断：牛肉供应紧张，何时缓解？
speaker: Alina Peng

segments.en: Tyson versus some of the other companies and the other producers how are they handling the shortage kind of the same pretty much everyone has done some sort of pullback in capacity just to make it a little bit easier to operate JBS did a similar move earlier
segments.zh: 泰森和其他公司、其他生产商如何应对短缺？差不多都一样，大家都缩减了产能，以便更容易运营。JBS早些时候也采取了类似举措。

segments.en: all of these businesses so far have been really relying on other segments of their businesses they profitable so their chicken business in particular has been doing pretty well just because consumer demand there has been very strong sort of allowing for continued year over your growth
segments.zh: 到目前为止，这些企业都依赖其他盈利业务板块，尤其是鸡肉业务表现不错，因为消费者需求强劲，实现了持续同比增长。

segments.en: we've had a couple of sort of oddball impacts that like this the screw worm was a big story earlier this year I hate to do that while you're eating breakfast on Sunday but also the lack of imports from Mexico both of those could turn could could that bring some relief for the months ahead
segments.zh: 还有一些奇怪的影响，比如今年早些时候的螺旋蛆虫事件，还有墨西哥进口中断。这些会不会在未来几个月带来缓解？

segments.en: yeah the meat packers have been talking for a long time about that source of supply from Mexico as like the biggest immediate thing that could help you supply so we basically used to import a million head of cattle and to be clear those are live cattle as opposed to like beef imports and those are brought into the US those animals are raised in the US for some time before being processed into meat
segments.zh: 肉类加工商长期以来一直把墨西哥供应视为最直接的缓解因素。我们过去每年进口约100万头活牛，这些牛在美国饲养一段时间后再加工成牛肉。

segments.en: but that trade has been pretty much on and off like largely off since like November 2024 or so just due to the spread of this like new world screw worm which like if it gets to animals it infects wounds and can be very deadly if not treated
segments.zh: 但自2024年11月以来，这项贸易基本中断，原因是新世界螺旋蛆虫的传播。这种虫感染动物伤口，若不治疗可能致命。
